For the purposes of items 7A and 7B of the table in subclause (1), a trade mark is covered by this subclause in relation to a statement of grounds and particulars if the trade mark is either:

if the statement of grounds and particulars is filed under regulation 5.7—a trade mark that the statement claims the applicant’s trade mark is substantially identical with or deceptively similar to for the purposes of one or both of the grounds in section 44 of the Act and regulation 4.15A; or
